SEVERVS PIVS AVG ; VICT PART M(AX)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, silver alloy, denarius of Septimus Severus (193-211AD). Obverse: Laureate head right. Inscription: SEVERVS PIVS AVG. Reverse: Victory running left holding a wreath in right hand and a palm in left hand. Inscription: VICT PART M(AX). Mint name: Rome. Reece period: 10. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin has two small recesses around the flan and some wear, especially on the reverse and so it is in fine condition. The coin is struck a little off centre on both sides.
